nodes.title: Fail-Closed Result Type
nodes.rationale: The Axiom integrity engine must guarantee that any verification failure is surfaced, never silently swallowed. Adopt a fail-closed result type pattern across all core modules.

nodes.title: PEG Parser Migration
nodes.rationale: Axiom needs a reliable, maintainable parser for its domain-specific configuration formats. Migrate to a PEG parser library with declarative grammar rules generated at build time.

nodes.title: DAG Parallel Execution
nodes.rationale: Gate execution has linear dependencies but many can execute in parallel. Model gate dependencies as a DAG and schedule independent nodes for concurrent execution using malebolgia.

nodes.title: SSOT Gate Registry
nodes.rationale: Gate metadata was scattered across multiple sources causing drift. Establish src/gate/topology_spec.nim as the single source of truth and generate all downstream artifacts from it.

nodes.title: Predicate-Based Gates
nodes.rationale: Early gate implementations mixed routing logic with verification logic. Separate gate behavior into predicates (what conditions trigger the gate) and runners (what verification executes).

nodes.title: CAS Cache Engine
nodes.rationale: Running the full gate suite on every commit was too slow. Implement a content-addressable storage cache keyed by SHA-256 hashes of gate inputs to skip unchanged gate executions.

nodes.title: PR Coverage Bot
nodes.rationale: Pull requests introducing new code often bypass verification gates. Deploy an automated bot that reviews every pull request for gate coverage recorded in the receipt log.

nodes.title: Theater Prohibition
nodes.rationale: Patterns emerged that created the appearance of rigor without actual guarantees. Formalize the theater prohibition policy — any code claiming a guarantee while guaranteeing nothing is theater.

nodes.title: Decision Binding Framework
nodes.rationale: Stateless agent sessions cannot discover the 'why' behind decisions. Implement a 4-pillar push-based decision narrative system: AST annotation pragma, Decision Knowledge Graph, Context IR 2.0 lazy injection, and a native deterministic linter with grandfathering waivers.

nodes.title: CI Baseline Gate & Ephemeral Proof Pipeline
nodes.rationale: CI baseline check risked becoming a meaningless gate due to fail-open/fail-closed ambiguity and empty cert directories on clean checkouts. Adopt a single hydrate path, macro I/O isolation, provenance truth separation, baseline exit contract, and volatile local vault to prevent proof regression and theater.

nodes.title: VKD Target Ratchet
nodes.rationale: VKD target could be silently under-selected, starving the VKD numerator and inflating apparent coverage. Adopt a monotonic ratchet formula max(cliLimit, ceil(kernelTotal x targetVkd) + 1, kernelTotal) with a kernelTotal floor for full kernel scope, fail-closed degenerate branches, and verifiableOnly+pureOnly certificate selection so every cert counts toward VKD.
